technical.summary: Strong short-term momentum with overbought RSI(9) and volume spike, but weak trend structure (low ADX), Ichimoku cloud resistance, and conflicting intermediate moving average signals limit swing entry conviction.

fundamental.summary: No actionable smart money signals detected; insider/institutional activity absent, government contracts and lobbying data unavailable, earnings in 34 days present timing risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (15/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is neutral with only small-amount sales and no senior conviction; lack of recent news data limits confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (369.92), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, rising dollar pressuring multinationals, with earnings event in 34 days adding execution risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong short-term momentum (RSI overbought, three white soldiers, 15x volume spike) combined with extreme fear sentiment (15/100) creates a contrarian buy setup with defined support at 152.42.
debate.key_bear_argument: Macro environment is severely hostile (VIX crisis, flat yield curve, rising dollar), fundamental signals are absent, trend structure is weak (ADX 21.02), and earnings in 34 days create execution risk that outweighs overbought momentum.
